newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan bank wants action against loan defaults.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan bank wants action against loan defaults.

text.p: State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) governor Muhammad Yaqub on Tuesday demanded "very severe punishment" for loan defaulters.

"The government and the opposition should legislate or amend the constitution providing for very severe punishment, including confiscation of the property, on loan defaulters," he told a news conference.

Yaqub said loans totalling 100.285 billion rupees were outstanding against defaulters by March 31, out of which 69.324 billion rupees were due from 500 defaulters. "Nobody should protect them who took billions of rupees," he said.
